translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yaubada la biga katotila baisa Baruki
E kwevasila kala taitu Yeoyakim matauna Yosaia latula guyoula Yuda, Baruki igini avaka bogwa laluki matauna. Oluvi aluki matauna
avaka Guyau, matauna Isireli la Yaubada, bogwa ilivala kawala, “Baruki,
yoku lokulilivala kawam, ‘Bogwa desi! Guyau bogwa eikatumkulovi ulo ninamwau eisakaigu vavagi mwau. Yeigu bogwa lasomata kayagigila, e gala gagabila babani agu yovaiwasi!’
“Mitaga yeigu goli Guyau, bakatudidaimi avaka bogwa lakaliaii e basisabu avaka bogwa lavali. Yeigu bavagi makawala baisa valu watanawa komwaidona.

Ki, yoku kusisavali avai vavagi kwemitawasi paila kam bwaina titoulem? Gala bukuvagi makawala. Paila yeigu bamai kabomwau baisa komwaidona tomota, mitaga paila yoku ambaisa ambaisa bukula, yeigu bakolaim e bukusisu wala tomomova. Yeigu Guyau bogwa lalivala.”
